reuse.why: The change lives in the shared getScheduleAmount helper all consumers use, though the edited approximate branch keeps its own 0.075 tolerance computation instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts (pre-existing).

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the change edits two return expressions in one helper and updates comments.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines the schedule amount resolution.

scope.why: Only the helper, its comments at the call sites and the matching tests are touched.

maintainability.why: A one-place rule change with simpler expressions (Math.min, amount - tolerance) and updated tests is easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all consumers keep going through getScheduleAmount
